units.source_text: 信辅认为自己只喝过瓶装牛奶，但却没喝过母乳这件事是奇耻大辱。

en.t: Shinsuke considered it a terrible disgrace that he had only ever drunk bottled milk and had never drunk his mother's milk.

units.source_text: 这是他一生最大的秘密，永远都不会向任何人透露。

en.t: This was the greatest secret of his life, one he would never reveal to anyone.

units.source_text: 对于这个秘密，他还有某种迷信想法。

en.t: He also held a certain superstitious notion about this secret.

units.source_text: 他是个脑袋很大，但是身体很瘦的少年。

en.t: He was a boy with a very large head but a very thin body.

units.source_text: 不仅仅是这样，他不仅容易害羞，而且胆子很小，是一个看见肉铺里明晃晃的屠宰刀都会害怕的少年。

en.t: Not only that, he was shy and timid, the kind of boy who would be frightened even by the gleaming butcher's knife in a meat shop.

units.source_text: 这一点——尤其是这一点，他可以确认自己完全不像经历过伏见鸟羽战役，在枪林弹雨中勇敢战斗过的父亲。

en.t: On this point, especially on this point, he could be sure that he was nothing like his father, who had fought bravely through the hail of bullets at the Battle of Toba-Fushimi.

units.source_text: 不知从何时起，也知是因为什么缘故，他认为自己完全不像父亲是因为喝牛奶长大的缘故。

en.t: At some point, and for some reason he did not know, he came to believe that he was so unlike his father because he had been raised on cow's milk.

units.source_text: 不，他还认为自己身体虚弱也是因为喝牛奶长大的缘故。

en.t: No, he even believed that his physical weakness, too, came from having been raised on cow's milk.

units.source_text: 如果这一切都是因为喝牛奶所导致的话，那么只要自己稍微示弱，那么他的朋友们就一定会戳穿自己的秘密。

en.t: If all of this was caused by drinking cow's milk, then the moment he showed the slightest weakness, his friends would surely expose his secret.

units.source_text: 所以，不管什么时候，他都会接受朋友们的挑战。

en.t: So, whenever the time came, he would accept his friends' challenges.

units.source_text: 当然了，这种挑战从来也没发生过。

en.t: Of course, such a challenge had never actually occurred.

units.source_text: 时而，他可以不撑竹竿就跃过御竹仓的大水沟。

en.t: At times, he could leap over the large ditch at O-takegura without using a bamboo pole.

units.source_text: 时而，他可以不用梯子就爬上回向院内高高的银杏树。

en.t: At other times, he could climb the tall ginkgo tree inside Ekoin without using a ladder.

units.source_text: 时而，他也会跟某个朋友打架。

en.t: Sometimes, he would even get into a fight with one of his friends.

units.source_text: 实际上，当信辅计划跃过大水沟的时候，他都能够感受到自己的膝盖因为恐惧而发抖。

en.t: In fact, whenever Shinsuke prepared to leap over the large ditch, he could feel his knees trembling with fear.

units.source_text: 不过，他总是紧闭双眼，用尽全身力气，一下子就跃过飘着浮萍的大水沟。

en.t: Even so, he would always squeeze his eyes shut, summon every bit of strength in his body, and clear the duckweed-covered ditch in a single bound.

units.source_text: 此外，当他爬上回向院内高高的银杏树时，或者当他和某个朋友打架的是以后，他的内心深处依然内恐惧和胆怯侵袭。

en.t: Moreover, when he climbed the tall ginkgo tree inside Ekoin, or after he had fought with one of his friends, fear and cowardice still assailed the depths of his heart.

units.source_text: 不过，他每次都能勇敢的克服这种恐惧和胆怯。

en.t: Yet every time, he was able to overcome that fear and cowardice with courage.

units.source_text: 如果要说这些都是因为迷信也无所谓吧！

en.t: If one wants to say that all this was due to superstition, that is all right too.

units.source_text: 但是，那肯定是斯巴达式的自我训练。

en.t: But it was certainly a Spartan form of self-training.

units.source_text: 这种斯巴达式的自我训练，使得他的右膝盖留下了永远都去不掉的伤痕。

en.t: This Spartan self-training left a scar on his right knee that would never disappear.

units.source_text: 也许他的性格也是这样——直到现在，信辅还清楚的记得父亲训斥他的话：“你就是个胆小却爱逞能的人，这样是不好的啊！”

en.t: Perhaps his character was the same way; even now, Shinsuke clearly remembered the words his father used to scold him: "You are a coward who loves to put on a brave front, and that is no good."
